channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: A man in Queens, New York, attempts to close a street to traffic with a metal barricade. A traffic stop in Florida turns tense when a woman refuses to sign a speeding ticket. An SUV in Utah gets rear-ended onto train tracks. A tow truck driver in Arizona has a fierce struggle to remove a motorcycle from the highway. Drivers in England fling projectiles at each other's vehicles. Biker bandits in Ecuador try to steal a woman's phone.
